firstPlayerRule: Whoever most recently fed an animal chooses the first animal token. All players then move their matching token simultaneously.
houseFallback: If the feeding criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose the first token chooser randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The player who chooses the token passes clockwise from round to round.
When playing solo, you choose the animal token each round.
The youngest-player instruction in the children's variant concerns end-of-game scoring, not who starts the game.
interpretation: The starting-player criterion selects the first token chooser; it does not give that player a separate placement turn.
